name: MagicBento-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The purple spotlight washes across several tiles and lights their borders, the strongest view of the glow effect.
frames.render_note: The grid sits hard against the left edge, so the first column's labels are clipped by the crop.

tagline: A bento grid of dark cards lights up purple under the cursor.
summary: Six dark feature tiles of different sizes form a bento grid with labels, titles and one-line descriptions. A purple spotlight and glowing borders follow the pointer across the cards.
appearance: Six near-black rounded tiles fill a wide grid in varied sizes, each with a small label at the top and a title plus a line of muted text at the bottom. A violet glow picks out the borders of whichever tiles sit near the pointer.
behaviour: Moving the pointer across the grid sends a soft purple spotlight after it and brightens the borders of nearby cards. Clicking a card sends out a quick radial ripple.
demo_content: Six tiles labelled Insights, Overview, Teamwork, Efficiency, Connectivity and Protection, with titles like Analytics.
search_phrases: bento grid of dark feature cards
cards with a purple glow following the mouse
click a tile for a ripple effect
saas features section with glowing cards
dark tiles that light up on hover
use_when: A product page needs a bento-style feature grid with a little interactive polish.
avoid_when: Card copy is fixed inside the file, and the purple glow is hardcoded so it fights another brand colour.
customise: Stars, spotlight, border glow, tilt, magnetism, click ripple, spotlight radius, particle count and glow colour are props; the six cards' copy is hardcoded.
weight_why: A fixed spotlight plus up to twelve looping particles per hovered card while the pointer moves.

a11y.note: Cards are plain divs with no roles or tab stops, and the glow and particles ignore reduced-motion settings.

issues: The six cards' labels and copy are hardcoded, so every page shows the same features.
Tile descriptions are tiny and dim against the dark cards, hard to read at a glance.
polish_why: A tidy dark bento with a smooth purple glow, but the tiles stay very plain and the copy is small.
